notes: Author-written questions, not part of FinanceBench. Each asks for one reported figure from the same filing as an eligible FinanceBench question (its parent), and inherits the parent's split so dev and reserved never share a filing. Written before any model answered them. Each is captured through the real retrieval pipeline like the FinanceBench questions; a question whose row is not retrieved is excluded.
